sources.title: GitHub - rubber-duck-debug/xielu: A fast vectorized implementation of ...
sources.snippet: XIELU implements a custom activation function with learnable parameters alpha_p (positive slope), alpha_n (negative slope), beta (scaling factor), and eps (epsilon for numerical stability). The activation function is designed to be differentiable and suitable for gradient-based optimization.
